name: 20-20-20 Break
description:
- Every 20 minutes, take a break from looking at your screen.
- Look at something 20 feet away from you.
- Do this for at least 20 seconds.

name: 20 minutes break
description:
- Move Around: Stretch or walk around to get your blood flowing and ease muscle tension.
- Relax: Take deep breaths, meditate, or do a mindfulness activity to clear your mind.
- Change your Environment: If possible, step outside for a bit or move to a different space to refresh yourself.
- Hydrate or Snack: Drink water or have a healthy snack to re-energize.

name: Drink water! Stay hydrated.
description: It's essential for health and focus.

name: Focus Time!
description: Focus on your task for the next 25 minutes.

name: Stretch
description: Stretch your legs and arms to relieve tension.
